chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with pending kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 45‑year‑old male with a long‑standing history of essential hypertension (since 1976) and obesity (BMI ≥30 since 1977). Prediabetes was documented in 1978, but insulin therapy has been ongoing, indicating overt type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic kidney disease. Progressive renal impairment was recorded as CKD stage 2 in 1978, advancing to stage 3 in 1992 and stage 4 by 1999. Proteinuria and microalbuminuria due to diabetes have persisted. Metabolic syndrome was diagnosed in 1983. The patient also has dependent drug abuse and limited social support, which complicate adherence and transplant eligibility. He has been on lisinopril, hydrochlorothiazide, and insulin. As of the latest data (2000), he is awaiting a kidney transplant and remains under moderate clinical complexity.
